name: feature-pack-users
title: App access Feature Pack
description: App access governance with member lifecycle controls, invitations, access profiles, direct and effective permissions, and new-member defaults.
docs:
`feature-pack-users` installed a provider-neutral view and `.constructive/feature-packs/users.json`. Import from `@/blocks/feature-packs/users/users-feature-pack`. The host must supply the view resource, policy, and actions; add `console-module-users` when Console Kit should own discovery and Constructive integration.

Degraded states: Missing resources or callbacks stay unavailable, while row policy, PostgreSQL privileges, RLS, and final-owner constraints decide mutations.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/users/
